description: NaC₄N₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded to six N atoms to form edge-sharing NaN₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.69 Å. There are four inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one C and one N atom. The C-C bond length is 1.40 Å. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three C atoms. There is one shorter (1.40 Å) and one longer (1.41 Å) C-C bond length. In the third C site, C is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one C and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the fourth C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one C and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.17 Å. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one C atom.
